title: "Activity 2/16"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
nba_data <- read.csv("nba2024.csv", header = T)
```

```{r}
summary(nba_data$PTS)
```


```{r}
ggplot(
  data= nba_data,
  aes(x= G))+
    geom_histogram(fill= "blue", color= "white", bin=10)+
    theme_minimal()+
  labs(title="G Plotted",
    xlab= "G", ylab= "Count")+
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept= mean(G), color = "red")
)
```
 
```{r}
factor(Tm)
```
 
```{r}
ggplot(
  data= nba_data,
  aes(x= factor(Tm)))+
  geom_bar(color="white")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle =90, size=10))
   theme_minimal()+
  labs(title="Tm Plotted",
    xlab= "Tm", ylab= "Count")
```
